planets.name: TOI-512 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-512 with a 7.19-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-512 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-512. Its orbit and size follow Rodrigues et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
